description_expanded:
Villa Menthe | Watercolor, FL

126 Bluejack Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Villa Menthe is a vacation rental home in the Lake District of Watercolor, Florida. This residence is privy to some of the best views of the Nature Preserve that borders throughout the community of Watercolor. Enjoy a private pool, 6-seat golf cart/LSV, spacious home with modern amenities, and a vacation you will not forget when you stay at 126 Bluejack Street.

The first floor of this residence welcomes you with light flooring, oversized windows, and an inviting decor. A guest bedroom with a king size bed and private bathroom is located at the front of the home. The open concept grand living space is perfect for the whole family to gather around. From the cozy living room into the gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, you will find a stylish dining table that offers seating for 8 guests. Off of the kitchen is the laundry and a half bathroom.

At the top of the second floor is a bunk nook with two twin over twin beds (please note there is not a door for the bunk nook). There is a guest bedroom with a queen size bed and shared access to the hall bathroom with a shower. The next bedroom offers a queen size bed and private bathroom. The master bedroom offers a king size bed, private bathroom with a shower and soaking tub, and access to the balcony. On the balcony you are treated to a ping pong table, bed swing, a fireplace, and stunning views of the Nature Preserve.

The third floor has an open space perfect for the teens or littles to truly enjoy themselves.

The outdoor space of this home is just as grand as the interior. First, enjoy a swim in the private pool (that can be heated for $65/day) or soak in the sitting spa. Next is a covered sitting space with plush seats gathered around the fireplace. Lastly is the grill that is perfect for those summer meals!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights:

Sleeps 12

4 Bedrooms

5 Full Bathrooms + 1 Half Bath

4,352 Square Feet

Private Pool (can be heated for $65/day)

6 Seat Golf Cart/LSV

Gourmet Kitchen

Beautiful Views of Nature Preserve

Spacious Balcony

Ping Pong Table

Outdoor Fireplace

Parking for 2 Vehicles

4 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

12 Amenity Wristbands

Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club

First Floor

- Guest bedroom with a king size bed and private bathroom

- Gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances including a Wolf range and Sub Zero refrigerator and dishwasher

- Bar stool seating for 4 guest and dining table seating for 8 guests

- Comfortable living room with plenty of seating

- Laundry room

- Half bathroom

Second Floor

- Guest bedroom with a queen size bed and shared access to the full, hall bathroom with a shower

- Guest bedroom with a queen size bed and private bathroom

- Bunk nook at the top of the landing with two twin over twin beds (please note there is not a door for the bunk nook)

- Master bedroom with a king size bed, private bathroom with a shower and tub, and access to the balcony with a ping pong table, porch swing, and fireplace

Third Floor

- Open media space

Outdoor Space

- Private pool (can be heated for $65/day)

- Grill

- Covered seating area with views of the Nature Preserve and pool

- 6 seat golf cart/LSV

- Parking for 2 vehicles

- 4 beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart/LSV per address- you may not rent a second cart/LSV if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart/LSV rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart/LSV rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts/LSVs.

- This home has a video/audio capturing doorbell mounted by the door and/or exterior cameras for safety.

- 12 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
